# vastdata_de_traces (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Query recent execution traces for a Data Engine pipeline.
# Timestamps (`start_time`, `end_time`, `start_time_after`, `start_time_before`) are in epoch microseconds.
# Use `pagination.next_cursor` / `pagination.previous_cursor` with the `cursor` argument to page through results.
data "vastdata_de_traces" "example" {
  tenant_name   = "de-lab"
  pipeline_name = "my-pipeline"
  limit         = 50
  order_by      = "desc"
}

output "traces" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_traces.example.data
}

output "traces_pagination" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_traces.example.pagination
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cursor` (String)
- `event_id` (String) ID of the CloudEvent compatible event triggering the Trace/Span
- `event_source` (String) Source of the CloudEvent compatible event triggering the Trace/Span
- `event_type` (String) Type of the CloudEvent compatible event triggering the Trace/Span
- `include_deleted` (Boolean) Include deleted pipelines in the results
- `limit` (Number)
- `order_by` (String) Sort order - ascending (asc) or descending (desc)
- `pipeline_id` (String) Pipeline ID associated with returned telemetries
- `pipeline_name` (String) Full name or regex pattern of the Pipeline
- `pipeline_vrn` (String) The pipeline's VRN
- `show_deprecated` (Boolean) Controls whether deprecated 5.4 (pre-aggregator) traces are merged into the results. When true, include results from the deprecated path in addition to the new aggregated path; when false, skip it. When omitted, the tenant global-config default (telemetries.traces.show_deprecated) is used. If the AggregatedTraces table has no rows, the deprecated path is queried regardless of this flag.
- `start_time_after` (Number) Timestamp since epoch for which traces should start after (exclusive)
- `start_time_before` (Number) Timestamp since epoch for which traces should start before (inclusive)
- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.
- `trace_id` (String) ID of the Trace assoicated with the telemetries
- `trace_type` (String) Type of trace to filter by (init, batch, event). Supports comma-separated values for multiple types (e.g., "init,batch")

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `pagination` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagination))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `end_time` (Number) End time of the Trace since epoch in micro sec
- `event` (Attributes) CloudEvent compatible event that triggered the Pipeline or Function (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--event))
- `linked_from` (List of String) a reverse direction of the "links_to" field of adjacent trace. For event traces, this contains the batch trace IDs that WERE CREATED FROM this event (i.e. event→batch links resolved via the AggregatedTracesLinks table).
- `links_to` (List of String) Trace IDs that this trace links TO. For batch traces, this contains the event trace IDs that ORIGINATED this batch and were processed as part of the batch execution (i.e. batch→event forward references written at aggregation time).
- `resource` (Attributes) Resource producing the telemetry, as in OTEL specification (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--resource))
- `start_time` (Number) Start time of the Trace since epoch in micro sec
- `status` (String) Status of the Trace
- `trace_id` (String) ID of the Trace
- `trace_type` (String) Type of trace (init, batch, or event)
